python3 << 'EOF'
from funcy import rcurry, get_spec

def add(a, b, c=10):
    return a + b + c

# Check what n gets set to
spec = get_spec(add)
print(f"spec = {spec}")
_, n, _ = spec
print(f"n = {n}")

# Now test @rcurry
@rcurry
def add2(a, b, c=10):
    return a + b + c

print(f"\nadd2(1)(2) type: {type(add2(1)(2))}")
result = add2(1)(2)
print(f"result = {result}")
print(f"type(result) = {type(result)}")
EOF
